Good morning, Talal,

Thank you for your response.

Unfortunately, we are still unable to offer a unit on the 6th floor. However, we have just had a unit become available today on the 19th floor, and we would be happy to arrange a viewing for you.

We hope the 19th-floor unit would be suitable for you. Please let us know, and we will be happy to arrange the viewing accordingly.

Thank you for your understanding.
